reviewAdvisory: The directive's figures contain no Brazilian beef tariff, no 55 percent rate and no 1 October 2026 date, so this named measure is asserted without any supplied evidence.
This attributes an intention to China that no supplied figure carries; the pledge is a financial commitment, not evidence of intent.
The 'historically covered' claim about APEC work programs is not in any supplied figure or document and is presented as background fact.
The body cites the CCCME listing and China Daily article as separate sources and the sources list names CGTN and China Daily, so the 'single document' confidence statement contradicts the body.
Site Rule 1 requires an identifiable primary document; 'Xinhua article on APEC meeting' names no headline, date or notice number, and the same vague label is used for every figure record.
The five-part record requires a period; 'announced at APEC 2026, ongoing' states neither a measurement window nor a disbursement period.
